notes.title: Litchi Town is officially part of Eastern Game Fest 2025!
notes.content:
Dear townsfolk,

We’re excited to announce that Litchi Town is officially part of Eastern Game Fest 2025! It’s an honor to join this celebration of Eastern charm and creativity, and to share with you the joy and serenity of childhood memories spent in the countryside.

In this game, you’ll take over a run-down farm and bring it back to life—plant crops, raise animals, forage in the wild, fish, feed stray cats, and explore mysterious caves. 

Cook authentic dishes, craft cozy furniture, decorate your dream home, and enjoy a life of slow, simple pleasures. Customize your outfits, bond with your neighbors, and experience the warmth of a tight-knit rural community—all while embracing the beauty of Chinese culture

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2349630/_/

The game is still in development, and for this event, we’re showcasing festive scenes, seasonal gameplay, and a wide range of charming illustrated NPCs.

notes.title: 【游戏征名活动】
notes.content:
大家好！我们陷入了一个史诗级危机！ 
没想到！游戏第一次出现在大家面前，就因游戏名激起了玩家心中的小小涟漪！ 
 
由于我们智慧的贫乏，给东西取名总是让我们苦恼~所以我们想要从广大玩家社群里，征集一些游戏的官方中文名！ 
只要在评论区留下你的创意，就有机会被我们采纳成为游戏的官方中文名！ 
 
【游戏介绍】 
国风模拟经营游戏《古镇物语》灵感源于制作团队儿时的乡村生活经历，忙碌高压的城市生活让人怀念起儿时宁静安逸的时光。与古镇中的邻里街坊交往熟络，种植瓜果蔬菜、养殖动物，建造房屋，打造属于自己的农场，在山野中寻找奇特的野果药材，研究中华美食，重拾生活的简单和快乐。 
 
【参与方式】 
在本帖下方按格式要求回复： 
游戏名字：XXXX 
为防止注水评论，需要按格式要求回复的才算有效名字哦~ 
 
【活动时间】 
4月18日-4月23日 
 
【活动要求】 
1. 游戏名无字数和格式限制 
2. 内容重复的评论，将以发帖时间最早的评论为准

notes.title: Litchi Town is participating in the Eastern Game Fest on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Litchi Town is pleased to announce that we are participating in the Eastern Game Fest on Steam!
During the Eastern Game Fest, Litchi Town will be displayed in the "Coming Soon" exhibition area.
Welcome to add Litchi Town to the wishlist and stay tuned!

The game is currently in development and will continue to be refined and added in the future.
The game is expected to release in the first quarter of 2024.

Litchi Town looks forward to meeting players who love games everywhere.
Eastern Game Fest: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/easterngamesfest
